_meta.purpose: Machine-readable companion to melodic_techno_spec.md section A. Numbers marked "measured" are pulled directly from Source/Engine/DrumRhythmGrammar.h (generated from MLPipeline/drum_grammar/output/drum_grammar.json) - not re-derived or rounded further here. Numbers marked "external" are sourced from melodic_techno_research.md and are NOT yet corpus-confirmed.
_meta.generated_from: Source/Engine/DrumRhythmGrammar.h as of the hat-groove-density-fix milestone
_meta.status: specification/reference only - not consumed by any code yet

kick.decayMs_status: not modeled in DrumVoiceSynth - external source only

groove_subset.source: measured, n=33 of 94 raw HAT loop files (density <= 12.5 onsets/bar)

excluded_roller_subset.note: 62% of the raw HAT corpus - continuous 16th-note loops, not a groove target. Excluded from hatClosed's stats by analyze_drum_grammar.py's HAT_GROOVE_MAX_ONSETS_PER_BAR filter.

camelphat_dense_alternative_external.status: documented but deliberately not the chosen target - see melodic_techno_research.md section 4

hatClosed.swing_status: not implemented - DrumEngine places all hits on an exact grid
hatClosed.hihat_choke_status: not implemented - external technique, no choke-group mechanism in DrumVoiceSynth

hatOpen.source_stats: kRideRhythm (RIDE loop corpus, n=19 files, since HAT loops don't distinguish open/closed)
hatOpen.note: ~7.5x density ratio across the 4-stage phrase arc, i.e. genuinely near-absent early, real presence only by the drop's later bars

percA_percB.note_on_two_values: corpus-wide raw average blends in continuous *Perc Loop*-named material; accent-subset figure is what the generator targets
percA_percB.percB_vs_percA_note: not a measured value - the corpus has no second percussion instrument category to measure; disclosed as a design rule, not data

ghost_kick_external.description: very quiet (-15 to -20dB) kick hits on off-beat 16th positions
ghost_kick_external.status: NOT confirmed in local corpus - 17 real kick loops measured 100% on-beat, zero off-beat onsets. External source only, flagged as untested.
